description: This file defines the internal class 'SiloInstanceTableEntry' which implements the ITableEntity interface for interactions with Azure Table Storage. It models a silo instance entry in an Orleans cluster, including properties for address, status, role, and liveness diagnostics, along with static methods for constructing and parsing row keys.

classes.name: SiloInstanceTableEntry
classes.description: Represents a silo instance entry in Azure Table Storage, including metadata and methods for serialization and unpacking row keys.

methods.name: ConstructRowKey
methods.description: Constructs a row key string for a given SiloAddress object following the format address-port-generation.

methods.name: UnpackRowKey
methods.description: Parses a row key string to extract the associated SiloAddress, handling format and errors.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SiloInstanceTableEntry object, including key details.
